enrichment.headline: Raises High School Linked Learning Office interim-support contracts to $70,585, up from $63,085
enrichment.summary: The Board is approving changes to the High School Linked Learning Office's 2022-2023 spending plan under the College and Career Readiness Commission's Measure N and H funds. Money is cut from facility rentals and from two stipend lines. An existing $63,085 contracted-services line for several independent contractors goes to $70,585. The contractors provide interim support while the Measure N/H Coordinator is on leave. The text does not state the amount added.

enrichment.summary: This change order adds soft play-mat tiles, a solar-reflecting track on the lower yard near the portables, and extra planting to the Kaiser Child Development Center site improvements. It covers two preliminary change orders (PCOs), numbers 27 and 28. The contract with Mar Con Builders goes up by $79,567, from $6,708,351 to $6,781,918 as stated in the text.

enrichment.headline: Hires King Construction Inspection to oversee Oakland Tech's solar battery storage project for up to $26,389
enrichment.summary: The district is hiring King Construction Inspection, Inc. to provide inspector-of-record services, which are independent construction inspections, for the Oakland Technical High School solar battery plant storage project. The contract is capped at $26,389, which includes up to $2,399 for additional services. Work is scheduled from June 13, 2024 to December 31, 2025.
